description: This source file defines the TaxonomyFieldTagsDisplayDriver class, which manages the display, editing, and updating of taxonomy field tags in OrchardCore CMS. It handles rendering views, processing form submissions, and interacting with content management services.

classes.name: TaxonomyFieldTagsDisplayDriver
classes.description: A display driver for managing the display, editing, and updating of taxonomy field tags in OrchardCore.

methods.name: Display
methods.description: Generates the display shape for a taxonomy field, supporting detail and summary views.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Prepares the editing shape for a taxonomy field, populating it with current taxonomy data.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Handles the asynchronous update of the taxonomy field based on user input, including validation and setting tag names.
